control_policy: Use explicit same-ref parking nodes contained in parking ways across all five snapshots; deduplicate exact way ID/version/node control identities. Every observed same-ref node must be at the final way node within 1m. Report all exceptions. No departure labels.
inference_policy: Only if the airport controls pass, materialize the existing final OSM node of a non-area, non-closed parking_position way for a full ref with no explicit parking node. Flag it as inferred from the documented way convention. Preserve any different-ref parking-node conflict as unresolved. Existing explicit parking nodes always take priority. No fuzzy stand aliases and no passenger gates.
interpretation: Distinguish changes of OSM representation from recorded position changes. An inferred endpoint is not a surveyed airport location; OSM edit times do not prove operational change dates.
prior_information: The explicit-node review has high current coverage but reports only 30.43% LFPG stable references because older snapshots often have parking ways without parking nodes. The archived OSM tag definition says to draw from the taxiway to the nose-wheel position, usually the final node. This review tests that convention against same-ref explicit parking nodes before resolving way-only records; no target or model score is used.
